local MIST_RED, MIST_GREEN, MIST_BLUE = 0.78, 0.80, 0.82 local MIST_ALPHA_MIN, MIST_ALPHA_MAX = 0.55, 0.85 -- Seconds for one full drift of the alpha. local MIST_PERIOD = 9 -- The second texture of a zone trails the first by this many radians. local MIST_PHASE = 2.1
local mistTime = 0 local mistUsed = 0
local mistFrame = CreateFrame("Frame", "WorldMapMistFrame", WorldMapDetailFrame) mistFrame:SetAllPoints(WorldMapDetailFrame) mistFrame:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() - 1)
local function BenillaMist_Texture(i) local texture = getglobal("WorldMapMist" .. i) if not texture then texture = mistFrame:CreateTexture("WorldMapMist" .. i, "OVERLAY") -- The Highlight art is a silhouette on black, made for ADD like WorldMapHighlight. texture:SetBlendMode("ADD") end return texture end
local function BenillaMist_Alpha(i) local phase = 0 if math.mod(i, 2) == 0 then phase = MIST_PHASE end local wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * mistTime / MIST_PERIOD + phase) return MIST_ALPHA_MIN + (MIST_ALPHA_MAX - MIST_ALPHA_MIN) * wave end
local function BenillaMist_Tint(texture, i) texture:SetVertexColor(MIST_RED, MIST_GREEN, MIST_BLUE, BenillaMist_Alpha(i)) end
local function BenillaMist_Seat() local mists = GetMapMists() local count = table.getn(mists) local width = WorldMapDetailFrame:GetWidth() local height = WorldMapDetailFrame:GetHeight() local used = 0 for n = 1, count do local mist = mists[n] local w = mist.textureX * width local h = mist.textureY * height for k = 1, 2 do local i = 2 * n - 2 + k local texture = BenillaMist_Texture(i) if w > 0 and h > 0 then texture:SetTexture("Interface\\WorldMap\\" .. mist.file .. "\\" .. mist.file .. "Highlight") texture:SetTexCoord(0, mist.texPctX, 0, mist.texPctY) texture:SetWidth(w) texture:SetHeight(h) texture:ClearAllPoints() texture:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "WorldMapDetailFrame", "TOPLEFT", mist.scrollX * width, -mist.scrollY * height) BenillaMist_Tint(texture, i) texture:Show() used = i else texture:Hide() end end end -- Hide the rest of the pool. for i = used + 1, math.max(mistUsed, 2 * count) do local texture = getglobal("WorldMapMist" .. i) if texture then texture:Hide() end end mistUsed = used end
local BenillaMist_OldUpdate = WorldMapFrame_Update function WorldMapFrame_Update() BenillaMist_OldUpdate() BenillaMist_Seat() end
-- The drift runs while the map is shown, as the driver is a child of the map frame. local driver = CreateFrame("Frame", "WorldMapMistDriver", WorldMapFrame) driver:SetScript("OnUpdate", function() mistTime = mistTime + arg1 for i = 1, mistUsed do local texture = getglobal("WorldMapMist" .. i) if texture and texture:IsShown() then BenillaMist_Tint(texture, i) end end end)
